summary.oneLiner: Branded B2C de-rated on a weak FY26 monsoon/season but base is low for FY27; the real margin lever is ramping the in-house technical (AI) plant from PBT-breakeven toward 8-10% EBITDA over 2-3 years, while a new herbicide unit debottlenecks formulation capacity for the next Kharif.

thesis (one line): Branded B2C de-rated on a weak FY26 monsoon/season but base is low for FY27; the real margin lever is ramping the in-house technical (AI) plant from PBT-breakeven toward 8-10% EBITDA over 2-3 years, while a new herbicide unit debottlenecks formulation capacity for the next Kharif.
scorecard (yoy):
| Metric | FY26 | FY25 | YoY | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | Rs. 1,138 cr | ~948 cr | +20% | Q4 rev Rs. 234 cr, +11% YoY (vs strong Q4FY25 base) |
| EBITDA | Rs. 101 cr (Rs. 1,005 mn) | ~75 cr | +34% | margin 9% vs 8% FY25 (CFO cited 8.73%) |
| EBITDA margin | ~9% (8.73%) | 8% | +~100bps | operating leverage + technical PBT-breakeven |
| PAT (reported) | Rs. 55 cr | ~35 cr | +57% | |
| PAT (normalized) | ~Rs. 55 cr | — | — | no major one-offs flagged |
| ROCE | 18% | 13% | +500bps | greenfield payback improving |
| ROE | 12% | 9% | +300bps | |
| Inventory | Rs. 2,074 mn | Rs. 1,385 mn | +50% | deliberate Mar-26 RM build vs West Asia risk |
| Cash conversion cycle | 87 days | 67 days | +20 days | inventory-driven; expected to ease |
| Net block | Rs. 3,097 mn | — | — | fixed-asset turns 4x vs 3x |
| Net worth | Rs. 4,491 mn | Rs. 3,944 mn | +14% | |
| Gross D/E | 0.29x | 0.29x | flat | LT borrowing cut to 510 mn from 641 mn; ST WC borrowing up to 809 mn from 514 mn |

**One-offs:** None material. Inventory bulge is a deliberate strategic RM build (March 2026) ahead of Kharif given West Asia supply/price uncertainty — a balance-sheet item, not a P&L one-off.
guidance (critical):
- **Top-line growth FY27:** 18-20% overall, expected across every vertical (15-20% per segment).
- **Branded B2C:** management expects 20-25% growth in FY27 if monsoon is normal (low FY26 base of +3%).
- **Overall EBITDA margin FY27:** ~9% currently → +0.5-0.75% improvement; targeting double-digit EBITDA margin within 2 years.
- **Technicals/backward-integration:** capacity utilization 65-70% in FY26 → ~75% next year; technical EBITDA margin ~5% now → 8-10% at optimum, but 2-3 years away; ~75bps/year improvement. Key lever = product mix + raising captive AI consumption inside own formulation division.
- **Exports:** expected to remain a good growth driver in FY27 (new country registrations ongoing).
- **CAPEX FY27:** ~Rs. 50 cr (units 2 & 3 / herbicide). Herbicide plant commissioning Q3 FY27, fully operational before Feb-Mar Kharif prep; benefits growth for next ~3 years (no incremental large CAPEX implied).
pipeline / new products:
- New product launches were notably fewer in FY26 (mgmt attributed to weak Aug-Sep consumption + no Rabi pest attack + channel destocking).
- Stated focus areas: first seed-treatment product planned; herbicide segment expansion on the growth roadmap.
- Technical plant: shifting product mix toward higher-margin molecules.
segment detail:
- **B2C branded formulation:** only +3% FYr26 (muted). Q1 FY26 was strongest branded quarter; Q2 follow-through weak from erratic Aug-Sep monsoon; Rabi muted (low pest attack + elevated channel inventory). Weakness concentrated in core West (Gujarat, MP, Maharashtra, Rajasthan); new states grew (4 new states' sales contribution 7%→14%). GP margin 35-40%. Marketing spend ~3% of B2C sales; Rohit Sharma signed as brand ambassador (campaign live from March).
- **B2B / domestic institutional formulation:** +15% YoY FY26, consistent. GP margin 15-20%.
- **Technicals (AI):** domestic AI +37% YoY FY26; +10% in Q4. Landmark year — achieved PBT-level breakeven. GP margin 22% (vs 19% FY25); EBITDA ~5% (vs negative ~-4/-5% FY25 at 58% utilization). ~25% of total sales. Depreciation+finance cost on the plant ~Rs. 22 cr/year.
- **Exports:** strong comeback in FY26 after disruption-hit FY25; registered in 2-3 new countries; new export team created. GP margin 15-20%, EBITDA 10-12%. Gulf shipment issue minor (Iran/Iraq small disturbance, immaterial).
growth / optionality:
- Technical (AI) plant ramp = primary company-level margin lever: utilization up, richer mix, more captive AI into own formulations independent of external pricing.
- New herbicide facility: relocates/expands herbicide formulation off the congested main site; existing herbicide unit converts to insecticide+fungicide capacity; eliminates external tolling in peak season (in-housing).
- Exports: continuous registration pipeline → new countries/customers.
- Brand revival optionality: low FY26 base + new-state expansion + brand ambassador.
margins & cost:
- Consolidated EBITDA margin 8.73% (FY26) vs 8% (FY25); guided to double-digit in 2 yrs.
- GP margins by segment: B2B 15-20%; brand 35-40%; technical 20-25% (product-dependent); export 15-20%.
- RM price inflation (crude-linked — packing, bottles, solvents) passed on time-to-time (weekly pricing decisions in volatile periods); only ~1-2% non-passable.
- Cost outlook: variable costs grow with revenue; fixed costs ~flat; employee cost +5-8% (semi-variable); other expenses (Rs. 54 cr FY26 vs Rs. 44 cr FY25) modest increase expected.
capex:
- FY27 CAPEX ~Rs. 50 cr (units 2 & 3, herbicide relocation/expansion). In line with prior guidance — NOT raised despite war/cost inflation.
- Herbicide unit: civil work near finishing, machinery being ordered (~4-5 months install); commission Q3 FY27; max utilization from next Kharif. Funds ~3 years of growth.
capital allocation:
- LT borrowing reduced (510 mn vs 641 mn) — deleveraging discipline; ST WC borrowing up (809 mn vs 514 mn) to fund deliberate inventory build.
- Gross D/E flat at 0.29x; strong operating cash flow / debt-servicing.
- No buyback/large dividend signalling; capital directed to organic CAPEX + WC.
risks:
- **Monsoon / weather:** core risk — uneven distribution / dry spells hit branded demand (as in Aug-Sep FY26). El Nino watch; mgmt views 90-95% rainfall + good water/reservoir levels as adequate if well-distributed.
- **Channel inventory:** elevated post strong Q1 FY26 → muted Rabi sell-through.
- **Raw material / geopolitics:** West Asia crisis → RM availability + price volatility; mitigated by Mar-26 inventory build & pass-through (timing lag risk).
- **Regulatory:** Andhra Pradesh banned Paraquat — mgmt says <1% impact (alternatives available).
- **Technical realization cycle:** external AI pricing was under pressure most of FY26; recovery only post-Feb-26 and partly input-cost-driven.
management tone: Confident and concrete; emphasized FY26 delivery in a "volatile" environment (uneven monsoon, soft technical realizations, West Asia disruption). Specific on segment margins/utilization. Repeatedly reassured on branded recovery ("100%", "no doubt") and supply preparedness. Q&A had recurring audio issues; mgmt steered participants to Hindi.
non-obvious points:
- Branded B2C % of mix optically fell mainly because technical (AI) sales scaled up — not because B2C shrank (B2C still +3%); denominator effect.
- Technical plant: ~Rs. 22 cr annual depreciation+finance cost is the hurdle — EBITDA of ~Rs. 22 cr at 5% just reaches PBT breakeven; operating leverage from here is steep.
- The Rs. 50 cr herbicide CAPEX is largely a relocation/debottleneck (herbicide already made in-house), freeing existing lines to convert to insecticide/fungicide — a capacity-mix play, not a new product entry.
- Inventory build + higher ST borrowing is a conscious bet on supply security, temporarily inflating CCC to 87 days.
challenges → beneficiaries:
- West Asia RM disruption / China+1 dynamics → favors integrated/backward-integrated agrochem players with captive technicals and pre-secured inventory (Dharmaj positioned via its AI plant + Mar-26 RM build). ✅
- Paraquat-type product bans → beneficiaries are alternative-molecule herbicide makers (Dharmaj claims insulated, <1%). 

---
qoq log: - **Q4 FY26 (this call):** FY26 rev Rs. 1,138 cr (+20%), EBITDA Rs. 101 cr (+34%, 9% margin), PAT Rs. 55 cr (+57%). Technical plant hit PBT breakeven (landmark), AI domestic +37%, utilization 65-70%. Branded muted +3% (monsoon); institutional +15%; exports rebound. Herbicide unit commissioning Q3 FY27. FY27 guide 18-20% growth, +0.5-0.75% margin, ~Rs. 50 cr CAPEX. Inventory built ahead of Kharif (West Asia). Rohit Sharma signed as brand ambassador.

themes.title: Agrochemicals & crop-input cycle recovery
themes.need: Crop-protection is recovering off a brutal trough, and Q1FY27 shows domestic branded volume decoupling from generic exports. RALLIS grew revenue only 7% yet lifted EBITDA 23% to a ~18.0% margin (+230bps) as domestic B2C rose 19% on +15% volume while exports COLLAPSED 28% (volume -35%) on Chinese pricing, and its seeds EBITDA margin went 26% to 30% on a rice/maize/millet mix versus price-controlled cotton - though PAT +31% is flattered by an INR 35cr employee-provision reversal of which INR 24cr is genuinely one-time, so normalise before extrapolating. The monsoon is the live variable: as of 8-Jul seasonal rainfall was ~15% below normal with kharif acreage ~21% below last year. SUMICHEM delivered record FY26 profitability; INSECTICID/DHANUKA/SHARDACROP ride premiumization + technicals; COROMANDEL/GNFC/CHAMBLFERT/GODREJAGRO add fertilizers + integrated agri.
themes.driver: Monsoon catch-up and kharif acreage recovery from ~21% below last year; domestic B2C volume against continued Chinese export price pressure; new molecule launches and biologicals scale-up.
